subject: Request: Custom SLA exhibit + evidence matrix for enterprise order form
participants_external: clara.evans@clearpathhealth.com (Clara Evans, Dir. Procurement, ClearPath Health)
messages:
From: Clara Evans <clara.evans@clearpathhealth.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com
Cc: alan.porter@clearpathhealth.com
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Enterprise SLA exhibit and evidence for order form

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our procurement review for the enterprise MSA we need a tailored SLA exhibit and the supporting evidence bundle to attach to the order form. Key asks from our side:

- Explicit uptime commitment for our production region (us-west-2) with regional failover windows and expected RTO for cross-region failover.
- Latency banding for P50/P95 token generation across common prompt lengths (<=128 tokens, 129-512, >512).
- Telemetry & evidence: sample 7-day latency histograms, KV-cache hit-rate definition/extraction method, and retention policy for per-request logs (we need 90 days as baseline).
- A carve-out for planned maintenance windows and a proposed credit schedule for degraded modes.

Attached are our SLA requirements (ClearPath_RFP_SLA_Reqs.pdf) and a short doc summarizing their legal team's preferred language for order form exhibits. Can you confirm what you can commit to, and which items will require legal review? Also please call out any evidence you can deliver during procurement (sample telemetry, SOC2 mappings, runbook excerpts).

We'd like to close the order form language this week if possible — Alan and I are coordinating internal timelines.

Thanks,
Clara
Clara Evans
Director, Procurement | ClearPath Health
clara.evans@clearpathhealth.com
Phone: +1 415-555-9211

From: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Clara Evans <clara.evans@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: alan.porter@clearpathhealth.com, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Enterprise SLA exhibit and evidence for order form

Hi Clara — thanks for the clear summary and the attachment. I matched your asks to what we can reasonably include in an exhibit and where we need legal/ops sign-off. High-level:

- Uptime: we can propose a 99.9% monthly uptime commitment for hosted production in us-west-2 with documented regional failover SLO. For Dedicated or Private deployments we will need tailored language (we can include an "Availability Exhibit" that callers can pick on the order form).

- Latency banding: we can supply P50/P95 figures for the three token-length buckets you listed. The exhibit will include the measurement methodology (inference concurrency, prompt normalization) and the sample histograms as evidence.

- Evidence: we can provide a 7-day sample telemetry bundle (anonymized traces and histograms), our KV-cache hit-rate definition, and an operations runbook excerpt describing failover steps. However, the latency histograms and the runbook excerpts are considered operational evidence and will be provided under an evidence-sharing addendum; legal wants a limited-scope NDA for runbook content.

- Maintenance carve-out: propose a 4-hour planned maintenance window per quarter with 48-hour pre-notice; credits for unplanned degraded modes tied to duration and % impact (I attached a draft credit schedule).

I attached a first-pass exhibit (jasmine_proposed_sla_exhibit_v1.docx) and an evidence matrix (evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx). Can Kimberly and Karthik review for legal/ops redlines? Clara, if you can highlight the internal procurement team’s non-negotiables (e.g., minimum uptime threshold, telemetry retention), I’ll get legal pointed at any redlines immediately.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com
+1 650-555-0148

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Enterprise SLA exhibit and evidence for order form

Jasmine / Kimberly — quick internal note.

- Legal: the proposed uptime & credit schedule look okay as a starting point, but legal will want the availability carve-outs enumerated (force majeure, customer misconfiguration, third-party infra).
- Ops: we can produce the sample telemetry package (7-day anonymized histograms + KV hit-rate calc) but we should not publish runbook steps in full; provide an excerpt and a controls mapping instead.
- Retention: we can do 90 days for per-request metadata; full request logs may only be available for 30 days in hosted mode without an evidence-retention add-on. If ClearPath needs 90 days across all log types, that will be an add-on.

I’ll coordinate a legal redline of the exhibit and flag the evidence bundle that is safe to hand over.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Reliability & Legal Liaison | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

From: Clara Evans <clara.evans@clearpathhealth.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com
Cc: alan.porter@clearpathhealth.com
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Enterprise SLA exhibit and evidence for order form

Thanks Jasmine & Karthik — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side after internal review:

- Minimum uptime: our compliance team requires a baseline of 99.95% for the primary region; can you run that against your telemetry and confirm feasibility or provide a deterministic rollback path if the number is not achievable?
- Latency: we want concrete P95 targets per bucket (not just sample histograms). If you can provide P95 targets with a tolerance band and a measurement method (edge vs. origin), that helps our SREs sign off.
- Retention: 90 days baseline is non-negotiable for per-request metadata for audit purposes; if that requires an add-on, we need cost scoped in the order form as a line item.

We attached an annotated PDF with inline comments (clearpath_latency_banding_comments.pdf). Also — we prefer DocuSign routing for the final exhibit; please confirm the routing path (legal -> procurement -> sign).

If we can get final redlines and a scoped pricing line for the retention add-on by Monday 11/1, we can proceed to DocuSign that afternoon.

Appreciate the quick turnaround,
Clara

From: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Clara Evans <clara.evans@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: alan.porter@clearpathhealth.com, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: SLA exhibit redlines, retention add-on pricing, and DocuSign path

Clara — circling back with the agreed next steps and attachments. Summary: 

1) Uptime: ops verified that 99.95% in us-west-2 is achievable for hosted deployments when customers adopt our regional failover defaults (active/passive with warm standby). We'll state 99.95% as the primary exhibit value with a defined exception list.

2) Latency targets: attached exhibit now includes concrete P50/P95 targets for your three buckets plus the measurement method (lookback window, warm cache assumption). See jasmine_proposed_sla_exhibit_v1.docx (Tab: Latency_Targets).

3) Retention add-on: we can provide a 90-day per-request metadata retention line item. Scoped pricing: $3,500/month for your account at projected throughput (this will be itemized on the order form). If you prefer annual billing, legal has an option for a 10% discount.

4) Evidence package: ops will deliver an anonymized 7-day telemetry bundle (histograms + KV hit-rate calc) once the mutual NDA is in place; a controls mapping will be included in lieu of full runbook content.

5) DocuSign path: routing proposed — Redwood Legal -> ClearPath Legal -> ClearPath Procurement -> Redwood Exec (jasmine) for final sign. I created a placeholder DocuSign link for the exhibit route: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/ABC-DEF-1234. Please confirm signatories and I’ll route through our CLM.

Attachments included: jasmine_proposed_sla_exhibit_v1.docx, evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx.

Next steps (action items):
- Clara: confirm signatory list and acceptance of the $3,500/mo retention add-on by 11/03 EOD.
- Kimberly / Karthik / Soojin: finalize legal redlines of exhibit and confirm the exact carve-out text for planned maintenance.
- Ops: prepare the anonymized telemetry bundle and controls mapping.

If all good I’ll open the DocuSign envelope on Wed 11/3 and tag it for expedited review.

Thanks everyone —
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
